Name: Junimo Checklist - Community Bundle Helper
Author: Feanor4
Description:
It ensures you don't accidentally sell Community Bundle items, shows a message on the bottom left when you hover over an item in the inventory or a menu.

I haven't tested it thoroughly with existing playthroughs, so backup save files beforehand. Let me know any issues you stumble across in the comments

It shows you the Item is required, the quality and number of the items required for the bundle.

If the same item is required in multiple bundles it will display two labels showing the required quality of both.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/42904/42904-1772249633-1897648043.png[/img]

Parsnips are required in the spring bundle and the quality crops bundle so it's listed twice.

The Horseradish is only displayed once since it's only in one bundle.

﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/42904/42904-1772249633-149283791.png[/img]
